title: MCP: a submitter's agent cannot recall or resubmit its own approval request — approval_recall / approval_resubmit are not ai.exposed, while the approver's four decide actions now are (ruling A on #32442)
body:
eval#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AcTB69pEwZ9ugr1g1w

Filing gate: ① product gap with a public-entry reproduction (an MCP client acting for the submitter), the submitter-side branch of ruling A on #32442 — per the meta-criterion "a new branch reuses the parent card's ruling and enters the queue directly". ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade.

## What happened

An end user's agent (a third-party MCP client, model GLM-5.3-Flash) operates an OA app on the `os-dev-test` environment for its user. It submitted an expense claim through the app's own `submit_expense_claim` action; the approval request opened (`approval_status: pending`). The user then updated the claim's line items and asked the agent to fill them in. The app locks the lines while the request is pending, so the agent needs to recall the request first. It cannot:

> 现在还撤不了 —— 这条单子的 approval_status 仍是 pending … 我这边没有撤回审批的可用动作(审批撤回属于审批中心的操作,MCP 只暴露了 submit_expense_claim 提交动作)。需要你操作一步:在 OA 里打开这张报销单 …,点「撤回」。

So the agent hands the step back to the person, who has to switch to the console for one click.

## Why

On `main` (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts`), PR #32886 (decide half of ruling A on #32442) declared `ai.exposed` + `requiresConfirmation: true` on `approval_approve`, `approval_reject`, `approval_reassign`, `approval_send_back`. The submitter's own actions on the same object — `approval_recall` (:787) and `approval_resubmit` (:829) — stay unexposed. Ruling A covered the approver's side only ("the approval request's own decide actions"), so the submitter's half of the same process is still UI-only.

## Expected

Same shape as ruling A, on the submitter's side: `approval_recall` and `approval_resubmit` declare `ai.exposed` with `requiresConfirmation: true`, forwarded to their approvals routes as the caller, so `ApprovalService` stays the only gate (its existing `approval_recall_not_submitter` refusal already keeps a non-submitter out). An agent can then "recall my claim, fix the lines, resubmit" end to end, with the user confirming each step.

## Steps

1. Any record-triggered or action-triggered flow with an `approval` node; submit a record as user U (the request is `pending`).
2. Over MCP as U: `list_actions` — no recall / resubmit action is listed (only the approver's decide actions, after #32886).
3. The only way to recall is the console's 撤回 button (`POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/recall`).

## Filing notes

- Business reason: every submit-then-correct cycle (expense, leave, purchase) run by an agent breaks at "recall"; North Star's "agents through MCP — every step of the road must hold for both kinds of user" covers the submitter as much as the approver.
- Reader who acts: the `domain:server` approvals seat that landed #32886 (same file, same pattern, its dogfood test `approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts` extends to recall/resubmit).
- Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue` for `recall approval MCP` (206), `submitter recall agent` (28), `approval_recall ai.exposed` (2), `approval resubmit MCP` (38) — none on exposing the submitter's recall/resubmit to AI; #32442 (approver side, ruled A, decide half landed), #32955 (approver cannot open a request, different).
